title: Chapter 6 – Dhyāna Yoga (The Yoga of Meditation)
subtitle: Yoga of Meditation

verses.title: 6.1 anashritah karma-phalam
verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
अनाश्रितः कर्मफलं कार्यं कर्म करोति यः ।
स संन्यासी च योगी च न निरग्निर्न चाक्रियः ॥ ६-१॥
verses.roman:
śrībhagavānuvāca
anāśritaḥ karmaphalaṃ kāryaṃ karma karoti yaḥ
sa saṃnyāsī ca yogī ca na niragnirna cākriyaḥ 6-1
verses.colloquial:
shrii bhagavaan uvaacha
anaashritah karma phalam kaaryam karma karoti yah
sa samnyaasii cha yogii cha na niragnir na chaakriyah 6-1
verses.translation_reworded: The Blessed Lord said: The person who carries out the duty laid upon him without leaning on the results of his actions is both a SAMNYASIN and a YOGIN. The one who has merely given up the sacred fire and all activity is not.

verses.title: 6.2 yam sannyasam iti
verses.sanskrit:
यं संन्यासमिति प्राहुर्योगं तं विद्धि पाण्डव ।
न ह्यसंन्यस्तसङ्कल्पो योगी भवति कश्चन ॥ ६-२॥
verses.roman:
yaṃ saṃnyāsamiti prāhuryogaṃ taṃ viddhi pāṇḍava
na hyasaṃnyastasaṅkalpo yogī bhavati kaścana 6-2
verses.colloquial:
yam samnyaasam iti praahur yogam tam viddhi paandava
na hi asamnyasta sankalpah yogii bhavati kashchana 6-2
verses.translation_reworded: O Pandava, understand that what people call renunciation is in fact YOGA. No one can truly become a YOGI without first giving up thoughts.

verses.title: 6.3 arurukshor muner yogam
verses.sanskrit:
आरुरुक्षोर्मुनेर्योगं कर्म कारणमुच्यते ।
योगारूढस्य तस्यैव शमः कारणमुच्यते ॥ ६-३॥
verses.roman:
ārurukṣormuneryogaṃ karma kāraṇamucyate
yogārūḍhasya tasyaiva śamaḥ kāraṇamucyate 6-3
verses.colloquial:
aarurukshoh muneh yogam karma kaaranam uchyate
yogaaruudhasya tasya eva shamah kaaranam uchyate 6-3
verses.translation_reworded: For the MUNI, the sage who wants to reach YOGA, action is described as the path. For that same sage once YOGA has been reached, inaction, or stillness, is described as the path.

verses.title: 6.4 yada hi nendriyartheshu
verses.sanskrit:
यदा हि नेन्द्रियार्थेषु न कर्मस्वनुषज्जते ।
सर्वसङ्कल्पसंन्यासी योगारूढस्तदोच्यते ॥ ६-४॥
verses.roman:
yadā hi nendriyārtheṣu na karmasvanuṣajjate
sarvasaṅkalpasaṃnyāsī yogārūḍhastadocyate 6-4
verses.colloquial:
yadaa hi nendriyaartheshu na karma su anushajjate
sarva sankalpa samnyaasii yoga aaruudhah tadaa uchyate 6-4
verses.translation_reworded: When a person has let go of all thoughts and feels no attachment to the objects of the senses or to actions, that person is said to have reached YOGA.

verses.title: 6.5 uddhared atmanatmanam
verses.sanskrit:
उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत् ।
आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः ॥ ६-५॥
verses.roman:
uddharedātmanātmānaṃ nātmānamavasādayet
ātmaiva hyātmano bandhurātmaiva ripurātmanaḥ 6-5
verses.colloquial:
uddharet aatmanaa aatmaanam naatmaanam avasaadayet
aatma eva hi aatmanah bandhuh aatmaa eva ripuh aatmanah 6-5
verses.translation_reworded: A person should raise himself up through his own Self and never drag himself down. This Self alone is one's own friend, and this Self alone is one's own enemy.

verses.title: 6.6 bandhur atmatmanas
verses.sanskrit:
बन्धुरात्मात्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवात्मना जितः ।
अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत् ॥ ६-६॥
verses.roman:
bandhurātmātmanastasya yenātmaivātmanā jitaḥ
anātmanastu śatrutve vartetātmaiva śatruvat 6-6
verses.colloquial:
bandhuh aatmaa aatmanah tasya yena aatmaa eva aatmanaa jitah
anaatmanah tu shatrutve varteta aatmaa eva shatruvat 6-6
verses.translation_reworded: For the one who has mastered himself through the Self, the Self is a friend. For the one who has not mastered himself, the Self behaves like an enemy, just as an outside foe would.

verses.title: 6.7 jitatmanah prashantasya
verses.sanskrit:
जितात्मनः प्रशान्तस्य परमात्मा समाहितः ।
शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु तथा मानापमानयोः ॥ ६-७॥
verses.roman:
jitātmanaḥ praśāntasya paramātmā samāhitaḥ
śītoṣṇasukhaduḥkheṣu tathā mānāpamānayoḥ 6-7
verses.colloquial:
jitaatmanah prashaantasya paramaatmaa samaahitah
shithoshna sukha duhkheshu tathaa maana apamaanayoh 6-7
verses.translation_reworded: The Supreme Self of a person who is self-controlled and at peace stays even in cold and heat, in pleasure and pain, and in honour and dishonour alike.

verses.title: 6.8 jnana-vijnana-triptatma
verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञानविज्ञानतृप्तात्मा कूटस्थो विजितेन्द्रियः ।
युक्त इत्युच्यते योगी समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः ॥ ६-८॥
verses.roman:
jñānavijñānatṛptātmā kūṭastho vijitendriyaḥ
yukta ityucyate yogī samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ 6-8
verses.colloquial:
jnaana vijnaana tripta aatmaa kuutastho vijita indriyah
yukta ity uchyate yogii sama loshta ashma kaanchanah 6-8
verses.translation_reworded: The YOGI who is content with knowledge and wisdom, who stays unshaken, who has mastered the senses, and for whom a clod of earth, a stone, and gold are all the same, is said to be harmonised (that is, to have reached NIRVIKALPA SAMADHI).

verses.title: 6.9 suhrin-mitraryudasina
verses.sanskrit:
सुहृन्मित्रार्युदासीन मध्यस्थद्वेष्यबन्धुषु ।
साधुष्वपि च पापेषु समबुद्धिर्विशिष्यते ॥ ६-९॥
verses.roman:
suhṛnmitrāryudāsīna madhyasthadveṣyabandhuṣu
sādhuṣvapi ca pāpeṣu samabuddhirviśiṣyate 6-9
verses.colloquial:
suhrin mitra aarya udaasiina madhyastha dveshya bandhushu
saadhushu api cha paapeshu sama buddhir vishishyate 6-9
verses.translation_reworded: The one who holds the same attitude toward well-wishers, friends, enemies, the indifferent, the neutral, the hateful, relatives, the righteous, and the unrighteous stands above the rest.

verses.title: 6.10 yogi yunjita satatam
verses.sanskrit:
योगी युञ्जीत सततमात्मानं रहसि स्थितः ।
एकाकी यतचित्तात्मा निराशीरपरिग्रहः ॥ ६-१०॥
verses.roman:
yogī yuñjīta satatamātmānaṃ rahasi sthitaḥ
ekākī yatacittātmā nirāśīraparigrahaḥ 6-10
verses.colloquial:
yogii yunjiita satatam aatmaanam rahasi sthitah
ekaakii yata chittaatmaa niraashiir aparigrahah 6-10
verses.translation_reworded: The YOGI should keep working to steady the mind, staying in a solitary place by himself, with body and mind under control, and free from hope and greed.

verses.title: 6.11 shuchau deshe
verses.sanskrit:
शुचौ देशे प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्थिरमासनमात्मनः ।
नात्युच्छ्रितं नातिनीचं चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम् ॥ ६-११॥
verses.roman:
śucau deśe pratiṣṭhāpya sthiramāsanamātmanaḥ
nātyucchritaṃ nātinīcaṃ cailājinakuśottaram 6-11
verses.colloquial:
shuchau deshe pratishthaapya sthiram aasanam aatmanah
naatyucchritam naatiniicham chaila ajina kusha uttaram 6-11
verses.translation_reworded: In a clean place he should set up a firm seat of his own, neither too high nor too low, made of a cloth, a skin, and KUSHA grass laid one on top of the other . . .

verses.title: 6.12 tatraikagram manah
verses.sanskrit:
तत्रैकाग्रं मनः कृत्वा यतचित्तेन्द्रियक्रियः ।
उपविश्यासने युञ्ज्याद्योगमात्मविशुद्धये ॥ ६-१२॥
verses.roman:
tatraikāgraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā yatacittendriyakriyaḥ
upaviśyāsane yuñjyādyogamātmaviśuddhaye 6-12
verses.colloquial:
tatraikaagram manah kritvaa yata chitta indriya kriyah
upavishya aasane yunjyaat yogam aatma vishuddhaye 6-12
verses.translation_reworded: Sitting there on that seat, with the mind brought to a single point and the activity of mind and senses under control, he should practise YOGA in order to purify the self.

verses.title: 6.13 samam kaya-shiro-grivam
verses.sanskrit:
समं कायशिरोग्रीवं धारयन्नचलं स्थिरः ।
सम्प्रेक्ष्य नासिकाग्रं स्वं दिशश्चानवलोकयन् ॥ ६-१३॥
verses.roman:
samaṃ kāyaśirogrīvaṃ dhārayannacalaṃ sthiraḥ
samprekṣya nāsikāgraṃ svaṃ diśaścānavalokayan 6-13
verses.colloquial:
samam kaaya shirah griivam dhaarayan achalam sthirah
samprekshya naasikaagram svam dishash cha anavalokayan 6-13
verses.translation_reworded: He should hold body, head, and neck upright, steady, and motionless, with his gaze fixed on the tip of his nose and not wandering about.

verses.title: 6.14 prashantatma vigata-bhir
verses.sanskrit:
प्रशान्तात्मा विगतभी र्ब्रह्मचारिव्रते स्थितः ।
मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः ॥ ६-१४॥
verses.roman:
praśāntātmā vigatabhīr brahmacārivrate sthitaḥ
manaḥ saṃyamya maccitto yukta āsīta matparaḥ 6-14
verses.colloquial:
prashaanta aatmaa vigata bhiir brahmachaari vrate sthitah
manah samyamya macchittah yukta aasiita matparah 6-14
verses.translation_reworded: With a calm mind, free from fear, steadfast in the vow of BRAHMACHARYA, with the mind under control, thinking of Me and keeping balanced, he should sit with Me as his highest goal.

verses.title: 6.15 yunjann evam sadatmanam
verses.sanskrit:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदात्मानं योगी नियतमानसः ।
शान्तिं निर्वाणपरमां मत्संस्थामधिगच्छति ॥ ६-१५॥
verses.roman:
yuñjannevaṃ sadātmānaṃ yogī niyatamānasaḥ
śāntiṃ nirvāṇaparamāṃ matsaṃsthāmadhigacchati 6-15
verses.colloquial:
yunjan evam sadaatmaanam yogii niyata maanasah
shaantim nirvaana paramaam mat samsthaam adhigacchati 6-15
verses.translation_reworded: By keeping the mind steady in this way at all times, the YOGI with his mind under control reaches the Peace that rests in Me, and that Peace ends in complete liberation (NIRVANA or MOKSHA).

verses.title: 6.16 natyashnatastu yogo
verses.sanskrit:
नात्यश्नतस्तु योगोऽस्ति न चैकान्तमनश्नतः ।
न चातिस्वप्नशीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चार्जुन ॥ ६-१६॥
verses.roman:
nātyaśnatastu yogo'sti na caikāntamanaśnataḥ
na cātisvapnaśīlasya jāgrato naiva cārjuna 6-16
verses.colloquial:
naatyashnatastu yogo'sti na chaikaantam anashnatah
na chaatisvapnashiilasya jaagrato naiva chaarjuna 6-16
verses.translation_reworded: YOGA is truly out of reach for the one who overeats and for the one who does not eat at all, for the one who sleeps too much and for the one who stays awake all the time, O Arjuna.

verses.title: 6.17 yuktahara-viharasya
verses.sanskrit:
युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु ।
युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा ॥ ६-१७॥
verses.roman:
yuktāhāravihārasya yuktaceṣṭasya karmasu
yuktasvapnāvabodhasya yogo bhavati duḥkhahā 6-17
verses.colloquial:
yukta aahaara vihaarasya yukta cheshtasya karmasu
yukta svapna avabodhasya yogo bhavati duhkhahaa 6-17
verses.translation_reworded: For the person who is moderate in food and recreation, moderate in effort while acting, and moderate in sleep and waking, YOGA becomes the destroyer of pain.

verses.title: 6.18 yada viniyatam chittam
verses.sanskrit:
यदा विनियतं चित्तमात्मन्येवावतिष्ठते ।
निःस्पृहः सर्वकामेभ्यो युक्त इत्युच्यते तदा ॥ ६-१८॥
verses.roman:
yadā viniyataṃ cittamātmanyevāvatiṣṭhate
niḥspṛhaḥ sarvakāmebhyo yukta ityucyate tadā 6-18
verses.colloquial:
yadaa viniyatam chittam aatmany eva avatishthate
nihsprihah sarva kaamebhyo yukta ity uchyate tadaa 6-18
verses.translation_reworded: When the fully mastered mind rests in the Self alone and is free of craving for every object of desire, then that person is said to be united (YUKTAH).

verses.title: 6.19 yatha dipo nivata-stho
verses.sanskrit:
यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता ।
योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः ॥ ६-१९॥
verses.roman:
yathā dīpo nivātastho neṅgate sopamā smṛtā
yogino yatacittasya yuñjato yogamātmanaḥ 6-19
verses.colloquial:
yathaa diipo nivaata stho nengate sopamaa smritaa
yogino yata chittasya yunjatah yogam aatmanah 6-19
verses.translation_reworded: A lamp set in a place without wind does not flicker. This is the image used for the YOGI whose mind is controlled and who is practising the YOGA of the Self (or who is absorbed in the YOGA of the Self).

verses.title: 6.20 yatroparamate chittam
verses.sanskrit:
यत्रोपरमते चित्तं निरुद्धं योगसेवया ।
यत्र चैवात्मनात्मानं पश्यन्नात्मनि तुष्यति ॥ ६-२०॥
verses.roman:
yatroparamate cittaṃ niruddhaṃ yogasevayā
yatra caivātmanātmānaṃ paśyannātmani tuṣyati 6-20
verses.colloquial:
yatra uparamate chittam niruddham yoga sevayaa
yatra cha eva aatmanaa aatmaanam pashyan aatmani tushyati 6-20
verses.translation_reworded: When the mind, held in check by the practice of YOGA, grows quiet, and when, seeing the Self through the self, he finds contentment in his own Self;

verses.title: 6.21 sukham atyantikam
verses.sanskrit:
सुखमात्यन्तिकं यत्तद् बुद्धिग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम् ।
वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः ॥ ६-२१॥
verses.roman:
sukhamātyantikaṃ yattad buddhigrāhyamatīndriyam
vetti yatra na caivāyaṃ sthitaścalati tattvataḥ 6-21
verses.colloquial:
sukham aatyantikam yattad buddhi graahyam atiindriyam
vetti yatra na chaiva ayam sthitah chalati tattvatah 6-21
verses.translation_reworded: When he (the YOGI) experiences that boundless bliss which the (pure) intellect can grasp but which lies beyond the senses, and, settled in it, never strays from the Reality;

verses.title: 6.22 yam labdhva chaparam
verses.sanskrit:
यं लब्ध्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः ।
यस्मिन्स्थितो न दुःखेन गुरुणापि विचाल्यते ॥ ६-२२॥
verses.roman:
yaṃ labdhvā cāparaṃ lābhaṃ manyate nādhikaṃ tataḥ
yasminsthito na duḥkhena guruṇāpi vicālyate 6-22
verses.colloquial:
yam labdhvaa chaaparam laabham manyate naadhikam tatah
yasmin sthito na duhkhena gurunaapi vichaalyate 6-22
verses.translation_reworded: When, having gained it, he regards no other gain as greater, and, settled in it, he is not shaken even by heavy sorrow;

verses.title: 6.23 tam vidyad duhkha
verses.sanskrit:
तं विद्याद् दुःखसंयोगवियोगं योगसंज्ञितम् ।
स निश्चयेन योक्तव्यो योगोऽनिर्विण्णचेतसा ॥ ६-२३॥
verses.roman:
taṃ vidyād duḥkhasaṃyogaviyogaṃ yogasaṃjñitam
sa niścayena yoktavyo yogo'nirviṇṇacetasā 6-23
verses.colloquial:
tam vidyaad duhkha samyoga viyogam yoga samjnitam
sa nishchayena yoktavyo yogo'nirvinna chetasaa 6-23
verses.translation_reworded: Know this: YOGA is the cutting away of the bond with pain. This YOGA is to be practised with resolve, with a mind that is steady and never gives in to despair.

verses.title: 6.24 sankalpa-prabhavan
verses.sanskrit:
सङ्कल्पप्रभवान्कामांस्त्यक्त्वा सर्वानशेषतः ।
मनसैवेन्द्रियग्रामं विनियम्य समन्ततः ॥ ६-२४॥
verses.roman:
saṅkalpaprabhavānkāmāṃs tyaktvā sarvānaśeṣataḥ
manasaivendriyagrāmaṃ viniyamya samantataḥ 6-24
verses.colloquial:
sankalpa prabhavaan kaamaams tyaktvaa sarvaan asheshatah
manasaa eva indriya graamam viniyamya samantatah 6-24
verses.translation_reworded: Giving up entirely every desire that springs from SANKALPA, and fully holding back the whole band of senses with the mind on every side,

verses.title: 6.25 shanaih shanair uparamed
verses.sanskrit:
शनैः शनैरुपरमेद् बुद्ध्या धृतिगृहीतया ।
आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत् ॥ ६-२५॥
verses.roman:
śanaiḥ śanairuparamed buddhyā dhṛtigṛhītayā
ātmasaṃsthaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā na kiñcidapi cintayet 6-25
verses.colloquial:
shanaih shanaih uparamed buddhyaa dhriti grihiitayaa
aatma samstham manah kritvaa na kinchid api chintayet 6-25
verses.translation_reworded: step by step he should arrive at stillness through a firmly held intellect. With the mind settled in the Self, he should think of nothing at all.

verses.title: 6.26 yato yato nishcharati
verses.sanskrit:
यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम् ।
ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत् ॥ ६-२६॥
verses.roman:
yato yato niścarati manaścañcalamasthiram
tatastato niyamyaitadātmanyeva vaśaṃ nayet 6-26
verses.colloquial:
yato yato nishcharati manash chanchalam asthiram
tatas tato niyamya etad aatmany eva vasham nayet 6-26
verses.translation_reworded: Whatever makes the restless, unsteady mind drift away, he should pull it back from that cause and bring it once more under the sole control of the Self.

verses.title: 6.27 prashanta-manasam
verses.sanskrit:
प्रशान्तमनसं ह्येनं योगिनं सुखमुत्तमम् ।
उपैति शान्तरजसं ब्रह्मभूतमकल्मषम् ॥ ६-२७॥
verses.roman:
praśāntamanasaṃ hyenaṃ yoginaṃ sukhamuttamam
upaiti śāntarajasaṃ brahmabhūtamakalmaṣam 6-27
verses.colloquial:
prashaanta manasam hyenam yoginam sukham uttamam
upaiti shaanta rajasam brahma bhuutam akalmasham 6-27
verses.translation_reworded: Supreme Bliss truly comes to this YOGI whose mind is fully at peace, whose passion has been stilled, who is free from sin, and who has become BRAHMAN.

verses.title: 6.28 yunjann evam sadatmanam
verses.sanskrit:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदात्मानं योगी विगतकल्मषः ।
सुखेन ब्रह्मसंस्पर्शमत्यन्तं सुखमश्नुते ॥ ६-२८॥
verses.roman:
yuñjannevaṃ sadātmānaṃ yogī vigatakalmaṣaḥ
sukhena brahmasaṃsparśamatyantaṃ sukhamaśnute 6-28
verses.colloquial:
yunjan evam sadaatmaanam yogii vigata kalmashah
sukhena brahma samsparsham atyantam sukham ashnute 6-28
verses.translation_reworded: By engaging the mind in this way (in the practice of YOGA), the YOGI, freed from sins, easily enjoys the limitless Bliss that comes from contact with BRAHMAN.

verses.title: 6.29 sarva-bhuta-stham
verses.sanskrit:
सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि ।
ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः ॥ ६-२९॥
verses.roman:
sarvabhūtasthamātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani
īkṣate yogayuktātmā sarvatra samadarśanaḥ 6-29
verses.colloquial:
sarva bhuutastham aatmaanam sarva bhuutaani cha aatmani
iikshate yoga yuktaatmaa sarvatra sama darshanah 6-29
verses.translation_reworded: With his mind brought into harmony through YOGA, he sees the Self dwelling in every being and every being dwelling in the Self. He sees the same thing wherever he looks.

verses.title: 6.30 yo mam pashyati sarvatra
verses.sanskrit:
यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति ।
तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति ॥ ६-३०॥
verses.roman:
yo māṃ paśyati sarvatra sarvaṃ ca mayi paśyati
tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati 6-30
verses.colloquial:
yo maam pashyati sarvatra sarvam cha mayi pashyati
tasyaaham na pranashyaami sa cha me na pranashyati 6-30
verses.translation_reworded: Whoever sees Me everywhere and sees everything in Me is never lost to Me, and I am never lost to him.

verses.title: 6.31 sarva-bhuta-sthitam
verses.sanskrit:
सर्वभूतस्थितं यो मां भजत्येकत्वमास्थितः ।
सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्तते ॥ ६-३१॥
verses.roman:
sarvabhūtasthitaṃ yo māṃ bhajatyekatvamāsthitaḥ
sarvathā vartamāno'pi sa yogī mayi vartate 6-31
verses.colloquial:
sarva bhuuta sthitam yo maam bhajati ekatvam aasthitah
sarvathaa vartamaanah api sa yogii mayi vartate 6-31
verses.translation_reworded: The YOGI who, grounded in unity, worships Me as the one dwelling in all beings lives in Me, no matter how he happens to live.

verses.title: 6.32 atmaupamyena sarvatra
verses.sanskrit:
आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन ।
सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं स योगी परमो मतः ॥ ६-३२॥
verses.roman:
ātmaupamyena sarvatra samaṃ paśyati yo'rjuna
sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ sa yogī paramo mataḥ 6-32
verses.colloquial:
aatmaupamyena sarvatra samam pashyati yo'rjuna
sukham vaa yadi vaa duhkham sa yogii paramo matah 6-32
verses.translation_reworded: O Arjuna, the one who, through the sameness of the Self, sees equality everywhere, whether in pleasure or in pain, is considered the highest YOGI.

verses.title: 6.33 yo yam yogas tvaya
verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
योऽयं योगस्त्वया प्रोक्तः साम्येन मधुसूदन ।
एतस्याहं न पश्यामि चञ्चलत्वात्स्थितिं स्थिराम् ॥ ६-३३॥
verses.roman:
arjuna uvāca
yo'yaṃ yogastvayā proktaḥ sāmyena madhusūdana
etasyāhaṃ na paśyāmi cañcalatvātsthitiṃ sthirām 6-33
verses.colloquial:
arjuna uvaacha
yo'yam yogah tvayaa proktah saamyena madhusuudana
etasya aham na pashyaami chanchalatvaat sthitim sthiraam 6-33
verses.translation_reworded: Arjuna said: O slayer of Madhu, this YOGA of Equanimity that You have taught, I cannot see it lasting steadily, because the mind is so restless.

verses.title: 6.34 chanchalam hi manah
verses.sanskrit:
चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद् दृढम् ।
तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोरिव सुदुष्करम् ॥ ६-३४॥
verses.roman:
cañcalaṃ hi manaḥ kṛṣṇa pramāthi balavad dṛḍham
tasyāhaṃ nigrahaṃ manye vāyoriva suduṣkaram 6-34
verses.colloquial:
chanchalam hi manah krishna pramaathi balavad dridham
tasya aham nigraham manye vaayoh iva sudushkaram 6-34
verses.translation_reworded: O Krishna, the mind is truly restless, turbulent, strong, and stubborn. I think it is as hard to hold in check as the wind.

verses.title: 6.35 asanshayam maha-baho
verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम् ।
अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते ॥ ६-३५॥
verses.roman:
śrībhagavānuvāca
asaṃśayaṃ mahābāho mano durnigrahaṃ calam
abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa ca gṛhyate 6-35
verses.colloquial:
shrii bhagavaan uvaacha
asamshayam mahaabaaho mano durnigraham chalam
abhyaasena tu kaunteya vairaagyena cha grihyate 6-35
verses.translation_reworded: The Blessed Lord said: There is no doubt, O mighty-armed one, that the mind is restless and hard to control. Yet, O son of Kunti, it can be held in check through practice and through dispassion.

verses.title: 6.36 asanyatatmana yogo
verses.sanskrit:
असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः ।
वश्यात्मना तु यतता शक्योऽवाप्तुमुपायतः ॥ ६-३६॥
verses.roman:
asaṃyatātmanā yogo duṣprāpa iti me matiḥ
vaśyātmanā tu yatatā śakyo'vāptumupāyataḥ 6-36
verses.colloquial:
asamyata aatmanaa yogo dushpraapa iti me matih
vashya aatmanaa tu yatataa shakyah avaaptum upaayatah 6-36
verses.translation_reworded: In My view, YOGA is hard to reach for someone whose self is uncontrolled. But the self-controlled person who keeps striving can reach it by the (right) means.

verses.title: 6.37 ayatih shraddhayopeto
verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
अयतिः श्रद्धयोपेतो योगाच्चलितमानसः ।
अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति ॥ ६-३७॥
verses.roman:
arjuna uvāca
ayatiḥ śraddhayopeto yogāccalitamānasaḥ
aprāpya yogasaṃsiddhiṃ kāṃ gatiṃ kṛṣṇa gacchati 6-37
verses.colloquial:
arjuna uvaacha
ayatih shraddhayaa upetah yogaat chalita maanasah
apraapya yoga samsiddhim kaam gatim krishna gacchati 6-37
verses.translation_reworded: Arjuna said: O Krishna, what becomes of the person who has faith but cannot control himself, whose mind drifts away from YOGA, and who therefore fails to reach perfection in YOGA? Where does he end up?

verses.title: 6.38 kachchin nobhaya
verses.sanskrit:
कच्चिन्नोभयविभ्रष्टश्छिन्नाभ्रमिव नश्यति ।
अप्रतिष्ठो महाबाहो विमूढो ब्रह्मणः पथि ॥ ६-३८॥
verses.roman:
kaccinnobhayavibhraṣṭaś chinnābhramiva naśyati
apratiṣṭho mahābāho vimūḍho brahmaṇaḥ pathi 6-38
verses.colloquial:
kacchin no ubhaya vibhrashtash chinna abhram iva nashyati
apratishtho mahaa baaho vimuudho brahmanah pathi 6-38
verses.translation_reworded: O mighty-armed one, having fallen from both, does he not perish like a torn cloud, with no support, lost and confused on the path of BRAHMAN?

verses.title: 6.39 etan me sanshayam
verses.sanskrit:
एतन्मे संशयं कृष्ण छेत्तुमर्हस्यशेषतः ।
त्वदन्यः संशयस्यास्य छेत्ता न ह्युपपद्यते ॥ ६-३९॥
verses.roman:
etanme saṃśayaṃ kṛṣṇa chettumarhasyaśeṣataḥ
tvadanyaḥ saṃśayasyāsya chettā na hyupapadyate 6-39
verses.colloquial:
etan me samshayam krishna chettum arhasi asheshatah
tvad anyah samshayasya asya chettaa na hi upapadyate 6-39
verses.translation_reworded: O Krishna, please remove this doubt of mine completely, for no one but You is able to clear it away.

verses.title: 6.40 partha naiveha namutra
verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
पार्थ नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते ।
न हि कल्याणकृत्कश्चिद् दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति ॥ ६-४०॥
verses.roman:
śrībhagavānuvāca
pārtha naiveha nāmutra vināśastasya vidyate
na hi kalyāṇakṛtkaścid durgatiṃ tāta gacchati 6-40
verses.colloquial:
shrii bhagavaan uvaacha
paartha na eva iha na amutra vinaashah tasya vidyate
na hi kalyaana krit kashchit durgatim taata gacchati 6-40
verses.translation_reworded: The Blessed Lord said: O Partha, there is no ruin for such a person, neither in this world nor in the next. My son, no one who strives to do good ever comes to a bad end.

verses.title: 6.41 prapya punya-kritam
verses.sanskrit:
प्राप्य पुण्यकृतां लोकानुषित्वा शाश्वतीः समाः ।
शुचीनां श्रीमतां गेहे योगभ्रष्टोऽभिजायते ॥ ६-४१॥
verses.roman:
prāpya puṇyakṛtāṃ lokānuṣitvā śāśvatīḥ samāḥ
śucīnāṃ śrīmatāṃ gehe yogabhraṣṭo'bhijāyate 6-41
verses.colloquial:
praapya punyakritaam lokaan ushitvaa shaashvatiih samaah
shuchiinaam shriimataam gehe yoga bhrashto'bhijaayate 6-41
verses.translation_reworded: The one who has fallen from YOGA reaches the worlds of the righteous, lives there for many long years, and is then born again into a pure and prosperous household.

verses.title: 6.42 atha va yoginam eva
verses.sanskrit:
अथवा योगिनामेव कुले भवति धीमताम् ।
एतद्धि दुर्लभतरं लोके जन्म यदीदृशम् ॥ ६-४२॥
verses.roman:
athavā yogināmeva kule bhavati dhīmatām
etaddhi durlabhataraṃ loke janma yadīdṛśam 6-42
verses.colloquial:
athavaa yoginaam eva kule bhavati dhiimataam
etad dhi durlabhataram loke janma yadiidrisham 6-42
verses.translation_reworded: Or he may even be born into a family of wise YOGIS. A birth like that is indeed very hard to come by in this world.

verses.title: 6.43 tatra tam buddhi
verses.sanskrit:
तत्र तं बुद्धिसंयोगं लभते पौर्वदेहिकम् ।
यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ कुरुनन्दन ॥ ६-४३॥
verses.roman:
tatra taṃ buddhisaṃyogaṃ labhate paurvadehikam
yatate ca tato bhūyaḥ saṃsiddhau kurunandana 6-43
verses.colloquial:
tatra tam buddhi samyogam labhate paurva dehikam
yatate cha tato bhuuyah samsiddhau kuru nandana 6-43
verses.translation_reworded: There he regains the knowledge he had gathered in his earlier body and strives harder than before for Perfection, O son of the Kurus.

verses.title: 6.44 purvabhyasena tenaiva
verses.sanskrit:
पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव ह्रियते ह्यवशोऽपि सः ।
जिज्ञासुरपि योगस्य शब्दब्रह्मातिवर्तते ॥ ६-४४॥
verses.roman:
pūrvābhyāsena tenaiva hriyate hyavaśo'pi saḥ
jijñāsurapi yogasya śabdabrahmātivartate 6-44
verses.colloquial:
puurva abhyaasena tenaiva hriyate hyavasho'pi sah
jijnaasuh api yogasya shabda brahmaativartate 6-44
verses.translation_reworded: That earlier practice carries him forward whether he wills it or not. Even the person who simply wants to know YOGA passes beyond the SHABDA BRAHMAN.

verses.title: 6.45 prayatnad yatamanas
verses.sanskrit:
प्रयत्नाद्यतमानस्तु योगी संशुद्धकिल्बिषः ।
अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम् ॥ ६-४५॥
verses.roman:
prayatnādyatamānastu yogī saṃśuddhakilbiṣaḥ
anekajanmasaṃsiddhas tato yāti parāṃ gatim 6-45
verses.colloquial:
prayatnaad yatamaanas tu yogii samshuddha kilbishah
aneka janma samsiddhas tato yaati paraam gatim 6-45
verses.translation_reworded: But the YOGI who strives with diligence, cleansed of sins and (gradually) perfected over many births, then reaches the highest Goal.

verses.title: 6.46 tapasvibhyo dhiko
verses.sanskrit:
तपस्विभ्योऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि मतोऽधिकः ।
कर्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी तस्माद्योगी भवार्जुन ॥ ६-४६॥
verses.roman:
tapasvibhyo'dhiko yogī jñānibhyo'pi mato'dhikaḥ
karmibhyaścādhiko yogī tasmādyogī bhavārjuna 6-46
verses.colloquial:
tapasvibhyo'dhiko yogii jnaanibhyo'pi mato'dhikah
karmibhyash cha adhiko yogii tasmaad yogii bhava arjuna 6-46
verses.translation_reworded: The YOGI is held to be greater than the ascetics, greater even than the men of knowledge (mere scholars), and greater than the men of action. Therefore, O Arjuna, (strive to) be a YOGI.

verses.title: 6.47 yoginam api sarvesham
verses.sanskrit:
योगिनामपि सर्वेषां मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना ।
श्रद्धावान्भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः ॥ ६-४७॥ 

ॐ तत्सदिति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासूपनिषत्सु
ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे
आत्मसंयमयोगो नाम षष्ठोऽध्यायः ॥ ६॥
verses.roman:
yogināmapi sarveṣāṃ madgatenāntarātmanā
śraddhāvānbhajate yo māṃ sa me yuktatamo mataḥ 6-47

oṃ tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu
brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde
ātmasaṃyamayogo nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ 6
verses.colloquial:
yoginaam api sarveshaam madgatena antaraatmanaa
shraddhaavaan bhajate yo maam sa me yuktatamo matah

om tat sat iti shriimad bhagavad giitaasu upanishatsu
brahma vidyaayaam yoga shaastre shrii krishna arjuna samvaade
aatma samyama yogo naama shashtho'dhyaayah 6
verses.translation_reworded:
And of all YOGIS, the one who is full of faith, whose inner self is merged in Me, and who worships Me, is in My view the most devout.

Thus, in the Upanishads of the glorious Bhagavad Gita, the science of the Eternal, the scripture of Yoga, the dialogue between Sri Krishna and Arjuna, ends the sixth discourse, entitled "The Yoga of Meditation."
